caption: Ready to sharpen your algebra skills for your upcoming exams? Tackle this classic question on factorising and simplifying algebraic expressions! Try it in the comments! Solution pinned below. #IGCSEMaths #OLevelMaths #BeyondTheEquation
solution:
Answer: 3x

1. Factorise the numerator: 6x^2 - 18x = 6x(x - 3).
2. Factorise the denominator: 2x - 6 = 2(x - 3).
3. Rewrite the fraction: [6x(x - 3)] / [2(x - 3)].
4. Cancel the common factor (x - 3): 6x / 2 = 3x.
